name: What components are required to properly frame a door opening?

mainEntity.name: What components are required to properly frame a door opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing a door opening requires king studs on each side, jack (trimmer) studs to support the header, a solid header sized for the span and load, and a bottom plate or sill. Short cripple studs fill the gap between the header and top plate. If you are modifying a wall during a remodel, it is critical to determine whether it is load-bearing before cutting any lumber. A load-bearing wall demands a properly engineered structural header and temporary wall support to hold floor or roof weight above, whereas a standard non-bearing partition wall uses smaller, standard lumber framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Door framing requires king studs, jack studs to carry the load, a properly sized header, and cripple studs above the header, with load-bearing walls requiring engineered headers.
